q-10291.name: Question 1
q-10291.worked_solution:
The function $f(x)$ is the sum of three power functions. So, we apply the sum rule, and we get

$$
\begin{aligned}{f}^{′}(x) & =\frac{\text{d}}{\text{d}x}({x}^{3}+\frac{1}{{x}^{2}}-x) \\  & =\frac{\text{d}}{\text{d}x}({x}^{3})+\frac{\text{d}}{\text{d}x}({x}^{-2})-\frac{\text{d}}{\text{d}x}(x) \\  & =3{x}^{(3-1)}+(-2){x}^{(-2-1)}-1 \\  & =3{x}^{2}-2{x}^{-3}-1 \\  & =3{x}^{2}-\frac{2}{{x}^{3}}-1.\end{aligned}
$$

q-10291.html:
Question 1
?

Find f′(x) for f(x)=x3+1x2−x.

a
6x2−2x3−1
b
3x2−2x3+1
c
3x2+2x3−1
d
3x3−2x3−1
e
3x2−2x3−1
Submit
Correct
EXPLANATION

The function f(x) is the sum of three power functions. So, we apply the sum rule, and we get

f′(x)=ddx(x3+1x2−x)=ddx(x3)+ddx(x−2)−ddx(x)=3x(3−1)+(−2)x(−2−1)−1=3x2−2x−3−1=3x2−2x3−1.

q-10726.name: Question 2
q-10726.worked_solution:
Here, we apply the addition, constant multiple, and power rules:

$$
\begin{aligned}\frac{\text{d}y}{\text{d}x} & =\frac{\text{d}}{\text{d}x}(5{x}^{15}-4{x}^{8}+7{x}^{5}) \\  & =\frac{\text{d}}{\text{d}x}(5{x}^{15})-\frac{\text{d}}{\text{d}x}(4{x}^{8})+\frac{\text{d}}{\text{d}x}(7{x}^{5}) \\  & =5\cdot \frac{\text{d}}{\text{d}x}({x}^{15})-4\cdot \frac{\text{d}}{\text{d}x}({x}^{8})+7\cdot \frac{\text{d}}{\text{d}x}({x}^{5}) \\  & =5\cdot 15{x}^{(15-1)}-4\cdot 8{x}^{(8-1)}+7\cdot 5{x}^{(5-1)} \\  & =75{x}^{14}-32{x}^{7}+35{x}^{4}\end{aligned}
$$

Question 2
?

Calculate dydx for y=5x15−4x8+7x5.

a
75x14−32x7−35x4
b
75x14−32x7+35x5
c
75x14−28x7+35x4
d
75x13−32x7+35x4
e
75x14−32x7+35x4
Submit
Incorrect
EXPLANATION

Here, we apply the addition, constant multiple, and power rules:

dydx=ddx(5x15−4x8+7x5)=ddx(5x15)−ddx(4x8)+ddx(7x5)=5⋅ddx(x15)−4⋅ddx(x8)+7⋅ddx(x5)=5⋅15x(15−1)−4⋅8x(8−1)+7⋅5x(5−1)=75x14−32x7+35x4

q-10729.name: Question 3
q-10729.worked_solution:
Here, we apply the addition, constant multiple, and power rules:

$$
\begin{aligned}\frac{\text{d}y}{\text{d}x} & =\frac{\text{d}}{\text{d}x}(3{x}^{4}+\frac{4}{{x}^{3}}+12) \\  & =\frac{\text{d}}{\text{d}x}(3{x}^{4})+\frac{\text{d}}{\text{d}x}(4{x}^{-3})+\frac{\text{d}}{\text{d}x}(12) \\  & =3\cdot \frac{\text{d}}{\text{d}x}({x}^{4})+4\cdot \frac{\text{d}}{\text{d}x}({x}^{-3})+\frac{\text{d}}{\text{d}x}(12) \\  & =3\cdot 4{x}^{(4-1)}+4\cdot (-3){x}^{(-3-1)}+0 \\  & =12{x}^{3}-12{x}^{-4} \\  & =12{x}^{3}-\frac{12}{{x}^{4}}\end{aligned}
$$

q-10729.html:
Question 3
?

Calculate dydx for y=3x4+4x3+12.

a
12x3−12x4+12
b
12x4−12x3
c
12x3−12x4
d
12x3+12x4
e
4x3−4x4
Submit
Correct
EXPLANATION

Here, we apply the addition, constant multiple, and power rules:

dydx=ddx(3x4+4x3+12)=ddx(3x4)+ddx(4x−3)+ddx(12)=3⋅ddx(x4)+4⋅ddx(x−3)+ddx(12)=3⋅4x(4−1)+4⋅(−3)x(−3−1)+0=12x3−12x−4=12x3−12x4

q-10739.name: Question 4
q-10739.worked_solution:
We first rewrite the function as

$$
y=-\frac{5}{{x}^{7}}=-5{x}^{-7}.
$$

Then, we apply the constant multiple and power rules:

$$
\begin{aligned}\frac{\text{d}y}{\text{d}x} & =\frac{\text{d}}{\text{d}x}(-5{x}^{-7}) \\  & =-5\cdot \frac{\text{d}}{\text{d}x}({x}^{-7}) \\  & =-5\cdot (-7){x}^{-7-1} \\  & =35{x}^{-8} \\  & =\frac{35}{{x}^{8}}.\end{aligned}
$$

q-10739.html:
Question 4
?

If y=−5x7, find dydx.

a
15x5
b
35x8
c
17x7
d
35x7
e
−35x8
Submit
Correct
EXPLANATION

We first rewrite the function as

y=−5x7=−5x−7.

Then, we apply the constant multiple and power rules:

dydx=ddx(−5x−7)=−5⋅ddx(x−7)=−5⋅(−7)x−7−1=35x−8=35x8.
